rec: Amulet of Glory (Teleports to Port Sarim and Edgeville)
enemies: Survive against Abyssal Creatures in multicombat in the Abyss

st.t: Start by talking to the Monk outside the Paterdomus temple, east of Varrock.
s: Sure thing, what do you need?

st.t: Use the Mithril 2H sword on Doric's Whetstone. (Doric is located north of Falador).
Use the bow-string on the Slender blade to make the Bow-sword.
Return to the monk near the Paterdomus temple with the bow-sword.
s: Yep, got it right here for you.

st.t: Use the Orb on the Large/Colossal Pouch. You will also be going to Entrana via the Abyss, so you must bank all combat gear.

Teleport to the Abyss with the Mage of Zamorak IN THE WILDERNESS (other players can attack you here). He stands a short walk north of the Wilderness ditch, north of Edgeville, where the River Lum goes underground. You will be attacked by monsters upon entering, and your prayer drained to 0!
Enter the central area through a gap/passage/eyes. Enter the Law Rift.
Enter the portal to leave the Law Altar.
Use the illuminated pouch on the Altar in the Entrana Church and watch the cutscene. Then talk to the High Priest in the church before you leave.
Go back to the monk near Paterdomus temple and search the dead monk's body.
Bank all weapons and armour, then talk to a Monk of Entrana at the Port Sarim docks to sail to Entrana (the Rat Pits Port Sarim minigame teleport is the closest teleport).
Cross the gangplank and talk to the High Priest in the Entrana Church.
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park to complete the quest.
